'''2016 European Championship Day 3 Tom Haid LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Haid]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Haid]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 3
